0022600102.text: The Clippers, 1-0 and first in the Pacific, visit the 1-0 Lakers, who sit second in the Pacific, and both teams have won their only game so far this season. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Lakers are missing Adou Thiero (knee) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain) and have Jake LaRavia listed as day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and they split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with the Clippers' most recent meeting, on February 20, 2026 in Los Angeles, ending in a 125-122 loss for them.
